operations.description: This API creates a readout of DTCs for one vehicle. If the result is available immediately, the result is returned. If the result isn't available, a location to the DTC readout is returned. This location shall be polled until the result is available. INFO: GET Requests are not yet supported!
operations.summary: View the List of DTCs for specific vehicleId.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] dtc data list by ecu using [PATH] vehicles dtc readouts [PARAMS] dtc ecu id status vehicle [SCHEMA] container data dtc type

operations.description: This API creates a readout of a DTC snapshot from one vehicle. If the result is available immediately, the result is returned. If the result isn't available, a location to the DTC snapshot readout is returned. This location shall be polled until the result is available. INFO: GET Requests are not yet supported!
operations.summary: View the List of DTC Snapshot for specific vehicleId.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] dtc snapshot readouts using [PATH] vehicles ecu id dtc id dtc snapshot readouts [PARAMS] dtc ecu id vehicle [SCHEMA] container data dtc snapshot type

operations.description: This API creates a readout of ECUs for one vehicle. If the result is available immediately, the result is returned. If the result isn't available, a location to the ECU readout is returned. This location shall be polled until the result is available. INFO: GET Requests are not yet supported!
operations.summary: View the List of ECU for specific vehicleId.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] ecu data list by vehicle id using [PATH] vehicles ecu readouts [PARAMS] ecu id vehicle [SCHEMA] container data ecu type

operations.description: This API creates a readout of available resources to the accessing party for one vehicle. If the result is available immediately, the result is returned. If the result isn't available, a location to the resource readout is returned. This location shall be polled until the result is available. INFO: GET Requests are not yet supported!
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] resource readouts using [PATH] vehicles resource readouts [PARAMS] id vehicle [SCHEMA] container data resource type
